purpose: Teach: 亭主/眼差し/就く/むかっ/無くなり/申さ/ゆけ/沈み

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家、亭主関白だな
lines.en: Your place is pretty traditional, huh? Your dad runs the show.
lines.style: Teasing observation, eyebrow up. Light challenge wrapped in a smirk. Leans back slightly, secure in the friendship that allows this kind of prodding.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、優しい眼差しが似合うな、桜
lines.en: You've got a real gift for that soft look, Sakura. Don't waste it.
lines.style: Slower tempo, sincere. Slight vulnerability underneath the words — he means it and doesn't quite look away. Warm but not sentimental.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、部長職に就く事になったな
lines.en: So you're saying Riku got promoted to section chief. That's huge.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact acknowledgment with real warmth underneath. No big celebration in her voice — just respect. Solid, grounded delivery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、走って駅にむかってたな、桜
lines.en: I saw you booking it toward the station earlier. Everything okay?
lines.style: Conversational but pointed — he's noticed something. Casual surface but genuine concern underneath. Eyes steady.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のシャーペンの芯、もう無くなりそうだな
lines.en: Your mechanical pencil's running out of lead, isn't it.
lines.style: Light observation, maybe slight teasing edge. She's caught him in a small detail. Warm rather than mocking — the noticing itself is the point.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、先生に「ありがとう」って何度も申される丁寧さだったな、桜
lines.en: You were so polite with the teacher earlier. Kept thanking them over and over.
lines.style: Wry, half-amused. He's calling out the over-politeness gently. Soft irony in the delivery — he gets why, but he's letting him know it showed.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、明日、学校にゆけよ
lines.en: Come on, you're going to school tomorrow.
lines.style: Direct but not harsh. This is encouragement disguised as an order. Warm firmness — she means it and he should know she cares.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テストで沈みがちだな、桜
lines.en: You get kind of quiet when there's a test coming up, don't you.
lines.style: Wry observation tinged with understanding. Slow, measured — she's not calling him out to embarrass him, just naming what she sees. The kind of thing only a real friend would notice.
